snippet.title: Socialiskigrad - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
We’re excited to announce that the official Steam page for our new title is now live!

In Socialiskigrad, players begin as the mayor of a newly formed nation, building districts tile by tile while balancing economic growth, public services, and social stability. As the republic expands, players can rise through the political ranks, with the ultimate goal of becoming the President of the Republic of Socialiskigrad.

#socialiskigrad #citybuilder #managementgame

Wishlist the game:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3651840/Socialiskigrad/
